claims.sentence: You can take courses and complete your studies in Russian, Tatar, or a foreign language, depending on your program and the university's regulations
These regulations are official university documents and take precedence over any course pages that may state otherwise or go beyond them
Russian is the primary language for your studies. Educational activities for secondary vocational education programs are conducted in the state language of the Russian Federation

The university may also offer instruction in Tatar. Teaching and studying of the Tatar language can be introduced in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation and the legislation of the Republic of Tatarstan
Teaching and studying of the Tatar language must not be carried out to the detriment of teaching and studying the state language of the Russian Federation

You may also complete your studies in a foreign language. Secondary vocational education can be obtained in a foreign language in accordance with the educational program and in the order established by education legislation and the local regulatory acts of the University
The evidence only covers secondary vocational education programs and does not specify languages for other degree levels
It does not list which specific foreign languages are available or which programs offer them
It does not state how to enroll in Tatar language courses or foreign language tracks
It does not define what constitutes instruction carried out to the detriment of Russian
It does not provide the text of the local regulatory acts or education legislation that govern foreign language instruction
Course pages may specify additional language options or differ from these regulations, but the official document takes precedence
